hypotheses.text: If Bastian Holt had shot instead of passing, the chance to score would have been lower than the 11.0% produced by his actual pass to Theo Varga.
If Bastian Holt had carried the ball forward rather than passing, the resulting chance to score would have been lower than the 11.0% from his pass.
If Bastian Holt had passed to Ilan Moreau (CM) instead, the chance to score would have been lower than the 11.0% achieved by his pass to Varga.
